mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate ampicillin's nephrotoxic potential and reduce antibiotic efficacy; ampicillin may displace chlorthalidone from protein binding.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes and renal function; ensure adequate hydration; consider potassium supplementation if needed; verify ampicillin dosing is appropriate for renal function.
